notes:
Summary: enterprise legal discovery vendor focused on regulated enterprise clients (financial services + pharma). Looking for private/VPC deployment with strict retention and audit controls. POC requested to validate embeddings + reranker pipeline at scale.

Key requirements:
- Indexing scale: target 10-25M documents (~3-7TB raw) for phase 1; expected growth to 50M+ in 12 months.
- Embeddings: batch + streaming ingest; prefer 1536-d or 2048-d open encoder; vector store must support efficient ANN and cold-start partitioning.
- Reranking: two-stage pipeline (sparse retrieve -> dense rerank). 95th pct latency target for rerank end-to-end: <300ms; tail latency critical for UI UX.
- Throughput: baseline 20 QPS for interactive users, burst to 150 QPS during discovery events.
- Cost sensitivity: high for per-query cost; want predictable unit economics and recommendations (Optimize features).
- Security/compliance: VPC-only private control plane, audit logging ingested to customer SIEM, retention policy enforcement, KMS integration for keys, data residency in NA/EU. SOC2 + ISO footprint required.

POC scope (requested):
- Index 10M doc subset (internal contracts + court filings) and run 500k sample queries to establish per-query cost and latency.
- Validate reranker models (quantized candidates + distilled reranker) and fallback policies to smaller models during capacity constraints.
- Verify audit log delivery to Splunk (customer).

Quote / Customer language from call:
- "We need an auditable chain for who queried what and when — can't have gaps."
- "If reranker tail latency spikes, legal reviewers lose trust immediately."
